name: Fetch publish status
description: Check the processing status of a TikTok video or photo post using its publish_id. Use this action to poll the status of content after initiating an upload or post. The API returns detailed information about processing stages (upload, download, moderation) and any errors that occurred. Non-terminal statuses mean processing is still pending — never re-initiate TIKTOK_PUBLISH_VIDEO for the same publish_id. Use exponential backoff when polling (e.g., 5s→10s→20s) to avoid the 30 requests/minute per access token rate limit.

publish_id.title: Publish Id
publish_id.description: The unique identifier (max 64 characters) returned from a video upload or photo post initialization. Used to track the posting action and check its processing status.

PublishStatusData.title: PublishStatusData

status.title: Status
status.description: Post processing state. Possible values: 'PROCESSING_UPLOAD' (file transfer in progress), 'PROCESSING_DOWNLOAD' (URL retrieval in progress), 'SEND_TO_USER_INBOX' (notification sent for draft completion), 'PUBLISH_COMPLETE' (content successfully posted), 'FAILED' (processing terminated with error).

fail_reason.title: Fail Reason
fail_reason.description: Error classification populated only when status is 'FAILED'. Possible values include: 'file_format_check_failed', 'picture_size_check_failed', 'frame_rate_check_failed', 'duration_check_failed', 'video_pull_failed', 'photo_pull_failed', 'spam_risk_text', 'spam_risk', 'spam_risk_too_many_posts', 'spam_risk_user_banned_from_posting', 'auth_removed', 'internal', 'publish_cancelled'.

uploaded_bytes.title: Uploaded Bytes
uploaded_bytes.description: Byte count for FILE_UPLOAD operations (1-indexed). Indicates bytes transferred during file upload.

downloaded_bytes.title: Downloaded Bytes
downloaded_bytes.description: Byte count for PULL_FROM_URL operations (1-indexed). Indicates bytes transferred during URL retrieval.

publicaly_available_post_id.title: Publicaly Available Post Id
publicaly_available_post_id.description: List of post IDs returned only after moderation approval for public content. Post IDs are available only if the post is published for public viewership and has been approved by TikTok's moderation process. Returned as strings — these are 64-bit IDs that lose precision if handled as JSON numbers.

PublishStatusData.description: Contains the status and details of the publish operation.

PublishStatusError.title: PublishStatusError

code.title: Code
code.description: Error classification code. Possible values: 'ok' (successful request), 'invalid_publish_id' (non-existent publish identifier), 'token_not_authorized_for_specified_publish_id' (access denied for this publish), 'access_token_invalid' (expired or invalid token), 'scope_not_authorized' (missing video.upload or video.publish permission), 'rate_limit_exceeded' (exceeded 30 requests/minute limit), 'internal_error' (server-side issue, retry recommended).

log_id.title: Log Id
log_id.description: Request tracking identifier for debugging and support purposes.

message.title: Message
message.description: Human-readable error description. Empty string when no error occurs.

PublishStatusError.description: Contains error information and request tracking details.

FetchPublishStatusResponse.title: FetchPublishStatusResponse

data.title: Data
data.description: Contains the status and details of the publish operation. Omitted when request fails.

FetchPublishStatusResponse.description: Response containing publish status and error information.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
